class.name: NetworkCodecs
class.brief_description: Register and run versioned codecs for game-defined message types.
class.description: Use [method Game.codecs] for a catalog tied to a game attachment or create an independent catalog with [code]NetworkCodecs.new()[/code]. Register the same game codec in each participant and select its identifier and version explicitly. The catalog neither sends packets nor adds a schema header to the payload. Encode and decode on the scene thread. When a game scope retires, its catalog releases the callbacks and further operations return [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE].

method.name: register_codec
method.description: Register one codec with synchronous callbacks. The identifier accepts 1 to 64 ASCII letters, digits, dots, hyphens, and underscores. The version is from 1 through 65,535. The encoder accepts a [NetworkWriter] and one game value and returns a Godot error. The decoder accepts a [NetworkReader] and returns a game value. An invalid registration returns [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER]. A repeated identifier and version returns [constant ERR_ALREADY_EXISTS]. A registry supports 256 registrations.

method.name: encode
method.description: Run the selected encoder with a new [NetworkWriter]. The result contains the complete payload only when the callback returns [constant OK] and all writes succeed. An unknown registration returns [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST]. A callback invocation error or invalid return type returns [constant ERR_INVALID_DECLARATION].

method.name: decode
method.description: Run the selected decoder with a new [NetworkReader]. The result contains its value only when the reader consumes the whole payload and records no error. A schema may reject data with [method NetworkReader.fail]. A successful decoder can return null. An unknown registration returns [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST]. A callback invocation error returns [constant ERR_INVALID_DECLARATION].
